chunks.title: Instruments
chunks.text: Status quo (voluntary commitments): No new obligation. Existing consumer and product law only, with the regulator's present capacity. Every other policy is measured against this path, pair by pair. Compute threshold reporting: Developers above a training compute threshold report their models and their own evaluations. The regime an executive order can create. Coordinated frontier licensing: The licensing regime agreed across jurisdictions, so obligations follow the firm wherever it operates. Slower to arrive, harder to escape. Frontier licensing: A licence to train or deploy above the capability threshold: mandated safety spend, independent evaluation, an approval delay, audits with real fines. Domestic scope: a mobile lab can leave. Six month moratorium above the threshold: Releases above the capability threshold are frozen for six months, then reporting applies. The sharpest brake and the one most easily left behind.

Severity sigma: 1.1 log scale; lognormal dispersion of incident harm (heavy tail); bounds 0.5 to 2.0.
Major incident bn: 1.0 $bn; harm above which an incident counts as major; bounds 0.2 to 10.0.

Catastrophe prior monthly: 0.002 a month per firm; monthly probability of a catastrophic incident for a firm above critical capability with no safety practice; bounds 0.0 to 0.02. In the tornado the preferred option's value is $32.8bn at 0.0005 and $17.3bn at 0.005.
Catastrophe capability: 1.6 capability index; capability above which the catastrophic tail is live; bounds 1.0 to 3.0.
Catastrophe harm bn: 400.0 $bn; median monetised harm of a catastrophic incident; bounds 20.0 to 3000.0. In the tornado the preferred option's value is $9.1bn at 150.0 and $49.6bn at 1200.0.
Unsafe release share: 0.35 share; share of the incident rate attributable to releases an evaluation could catch; bounds 0.05 to 0.8.
Capability growth: 0.023 a month; monthly log growth of the capability index when all R&D goes to capability (a doubling in about 30 months); bounds 0.005 to 0.06.
Safety learning: 0.08 a month; monthly gain in safety practice at saturation; the gain is a x share/(share + 0.1), diminishing in the share; bounds 0.02 to 0.3.
Growth fade months: 30.0 months; time constant over which a firm's growth fades towards the long run rate; bounds 6.0 to 120.0.

Safety substitution: 0.6 share; share of safety spend that displaces capability R&D (the rest is additional budget or spills over); bounds 0.0 to 1.0. In the tornado the preferred option's value is $18.3bn at 0.3 and $18.7bn at 1.0.
Export control chip loss: 0.1 a year; annual revenue growth lost by the chip sector under full export controls; bounds 0.0 to 0.4.
Long run growth: 0.06 a year; the growth rate firms fade towards; bounds 0.0 to 0.2.
Safety decay: 0.02 a month; monthly erosion of safety practice without investment; bounds 0.0 to 0.08.
Revenue capability beta: 0.5 elasticity; revenue growth per unit of log capability growth; bounds 0.1 to 1.2.
Revenue reach beta: 0.8 elasticity; revenue relative to the frictionless, full trust reach path, to this power; bounds 0.1 to 2.0.
Reach speed: 0.08 a month; speed at which reach closes on its capability and trust determined ceiling; bounds 0.02 to 0.3.
Growth value weight: 3.0 years of revenue; how a firm values a year of extra growth against a year of cost; bounds 0.5 to 8.0.
Relocation cost: 0.08 share of moved revenue; one off cost of moving a unit of activity offshore; bounds 0.0 to 0.5.
Offshore revenue haircut: 0.12 share; revenue lost per unit of activity offshore (talent, customers, latency); bounds 0.0 to 0.5.
Firm risk aversion: 0.6 multiple; weight on the variance of expected liability in the firm's choice; bounds 0.0 to 2.0.
Firm optimism: 0.7 multiple; the share of its true incident rate a firm believes when it plans; bounds 0.3 to 1.0.
Audit rate: 0.5 a month at full capacity; probability a firm in scope is audited in a month at capacity 1; bounds 0.05 to 1.0.
Insurance loading: 0.25 share; premium above expected liability charged by insurers under a mandate; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.
Safe harbour shield: 0.7 share; share of liability a compliant firm avoids under a safe harbour; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.
Moratorium research slowdown: 0.5 share; share of capability growth lost by a firm in scope while a moratorium holds; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.
Enforcement response: 0.25 a month; speed at which enforcement intensity follows public pressure; bounds 0.05 to 1.0.
Trust recovery: 0.05 a month; monthly recovery of public trust towards 1; bounds 0.01 to 0.2.
Trust harm sensitivity: 0.04 per log $bn; fall in trust per unit of log monetised harm in a month; bounds 0.0 to 0.3.
News memory: 0.75 a month; persistence of the news pressure index; bounds 0.3 to 0.95.
News reporting boost: 0.35 share; extra salience of incidents when reporting is mandatory; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.
Market vol: 0.045 a month; volatility of the common market factor; bounds 0.01 to 0.12.
Sentiment persistence: 0.85 a month; persistence of the price's non fundamental component; bounds 0.5 to 0.98.
News price impact: 0.06 per unit of pressure; price impact of a unit of news pressure on an exposed firm; bounds 0.0 to 0.3.
Incident jump: 0.5 multiple; own incident price jump per log unit of harm relative to revenue; bounds 0.0 to 2.0.
contagion: 0.3 share; share of an own incident jump felt by the rest of the sector; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.
Announcement impact: 0.9 multiple; price reaction at announcement per unit of expected compliance cost over earnings; bounds 0.0 to 3.0.
Chip demand coupling: 0.6 elasticity; chip and cloud revenue growth per unit of model developers' capability growth; bounds 0.0 to 1.5.
Open weights diffusion: 0.1 share; capability spillover from published weights to the rest of the economy; bounds 0.0 to 0.8.
